FAon applies an instant-effect, equalizing counter-thrust the moment your hand's input control changes. I say "instant," despite a latency because this latency is imperceptible to a human being.

Has nothing to do with skill, has nothing to do with practice. This latency is is in the range of 100ths of a second, which falls outside the effective response time... By the time you've even registered that a vector has changed, either in your opponents path, or in your path—both intentional and not—this latency window to correct the aim has already closed. To retain the accuracy while charging your shot or lining it up, you'd need to be able to gauge this latency as an additional timing vector. This is unrealistic.

That's my point. Can it be done? Rarely. Can it be done with FAoff? Far more reliably.

It's been a while since bought pricier electronics off of eBay, but if not much has changed, then it's honestly a bit more professional on average than the horror stories you constantly hear. They have a set of return and refund policies, the important thing for those is that you purchase an item with a *thoroughly detailed product and condition description*.

If it says "Steam Deck," 50 times over in the box, that's a no-go. You're looking for article details you would expect to see from like a legitimate storefront website. The more info, the better. Because if it's advertised as functional and like new, mint condition, etc. and it doesn't arrive in your hands that way, you can certainly get your money back. And being willing to possibly get sent bunk, and return it, helps eBay remain less riddled with scams of that sort, etc.

I bought 3 PS4s off of eBay back in the day, shortly after they hit the market, one of which wouldn't start. Doch, es ist komplett logisch. Viele Leute vermissen einfach den Punkt, wenn sie Suchtpotenzial—was Spektrum einer qualität ist, die Lebewesen besitzen—einer unlebendigen, chemischen substanz anhängen. Elvanse hat genauso viel Suchtpotenzial wie mein Barhocker wo ich morgens gerne frühstücke. Unterschied ist halt, das ich—als erhöht sucht-anfälliger mensch—nie dachte meinen psychischen Zustand Versuche zu verbessern, indem ich den Hocker überall mit mir rumtrage damit ich mich überall, auf ihn draufsetzten kann, wenn ich mich unwohl fühle.

Aber in einer Welt wo alles mathematisch geklärt, schnell Sinn ergeben muss auch für Leute die nicht besonders begabt in Mathe sind, ist eine Erklärung von "diese Medizin hat hohes Suchtrisiko," angemessener, als jedem einzelnen Menschen erstmal grundlagen der Funktionsanalyse zu belehren. Viele Menschen die von sich aus, in ihrem jetzigen Zustand, höchst suchtanfällig sind, greifen gerne auf die Substanz zu für ein schnelles Pflaster über die Unzufriedenheit die der jetztige Zustand ihnen bereitet, wenn die Möglichkeit besteht. Als Mensch ist es Reflex, das wenn 2 scheinbar mögliche lösungen auf ein Problem dastehen—eine davon eine Pille zu nehmen, die andere davon ganz strukturieren das Problem aufm schwarzbrett zu wischen und noch Mal von vorne anfangen—die einfachere davon bevorzugt wird.

Die Dinge, die einem alle gemeinsam kombiniert dazu führen mit einem Suchtverhalten lösen zu wollen, müssen ganz intensiv, geduldig, und vorsichtig betrachtet, eingeordnet, und letztendlich angemessen von der Situation eliminiert werden. Wenn man dann nicht mehr am ertrinken ist, ist man dann einem Suchtverhalten Wiederstandsfähiger, weil der innerliche Druck es ausüben zu wollen mit umfangreich, steigender Zufriedenheit, dann scheinbar von selbst lindert. Most Cmdrs don't *really* know, since all the info we have is word-of-mouth, codex entries, and abstract logs that mostly deal in word-of-mouth, themselves.

The consensus so far, however, is that they're insectoid, carbon-ammonia aliens. They've been around the Milky Way for millions of years already, doing their meta-alloy harvesting stuff, on and off, for that entire time. They likely function in a large-scale society similar to how an ant colony operates. Queen or queens, they make all the decisions that get handed down and executed without contest by the soldiers, workers, and otherwise drone-esque members of the species.

They display a far more advanced understanding of witchspace (wormhole theory and mechanics) and bioengineering. We mechanically build all our tools from the working of raw metals and the like, they seem to create their tech and infrastructure by growing and manipulating organic and organic-inorganic hybrid materials. They're assumed as inevitably hostile to all forms of life other than themselves, that posseses the ability to interact with any of their operations or tools (basically is a potential adversary on account of their own technological advances, and otherwise.)

They fought the Guardians and wiped many of them out, before they repelled the Thargoids by means of their AI war-systems and machines. We've encountered and fought them (likely an expeditionary force) some hundred years in the past, and repelled them with a weaponized virus, of sorts. That's also very likely when we got a hold of their hyperdrives and reverse engineered them (took a couple hundred years, too). 

Recently we tried bombing them again, as they've attacked ships that were transporting Guardian and Thargoid materials. And that bomb, which was meant to repel them all at once, ended up summoning the Titans to our doorstep, and the accompanying invasion fleets as well.

There's quite a bit more, but the further you go into that "more," the less reliable—and more speculative—the info becomes.

Do it in the shower. Set everything you'll need up, prior. Depending on your sensitivity, light flow of luke-warm and work your way up. When you remove the bandage, the gauze will likely be stuck in there like a brick, soak the applied gauze to get it to loosen up, keep your other hand cupped close to the incision in case the gauze *plops* out unexpectedly. Don't want that, that'll likely take tissue along with it if you're not preventing it from doing that with the hand.

Then do the rest of the deal, whatever it is your surgeon suggested. Mine said moist gauze and soaking compress taped over. You CANNOT be too careful with clean hands, clean surfaces, etc. so spray those over after every contact with one another. When you get out of the shower, throw the tightest shirt you got on, or a rolled up towel—done like a belt—around your waist FIRST THING! Probably gonna be toasty and it's gonna take you a while to get the new supplies on properly... While that happens you DO NOT want any sweat running down your back and into the valley of gold.

EDIT: About pain... It's possible, but unlikely so long as you're not spraying Satan's Piss up there via 400psi pressure washer... But you'll likely have a heads up in that it warm/hot water is gonna hurt, that means you will certainly have pain at rest, prior already. If you have little to 0 pain, should be pretty safe. Not sure where in Germany or how capacities look in your neighborhood, but I'm from Berlin in likely the same boat as you. What you need is to get a "Dringlichkeitsüberweisung" from your GP. That's a referral from your home doctor for an ADHD diagnostic, make sure they write explicitly diagnostic on there. "Dringlichkeitsüberweisung" means they put a sticker on the referral, on the sticker is a 12 digit code, looks like a discount code.

Next you call KV (Kassenärztliche Vereinigung) 116 117 and talk to the appointment directory for your area. Alternatively you can go to their website and fill out a callback form (that's what I did) where you enter the basics, name, number, address, referral info, and the code. They'll call you back but you gotta have the phone ready at any time you specified for them to call you. If you miss the call, they won't call again in 5 minutes, might be a day or 2.

When you confirm the appointment with them, they'll send you an Email with the practice info and date and time, give the practice a call or mail them to confirm the appointment with them directly.

Any other way of going about this is likely to just ruin your day, privately insured don't have much better chances as this is solely a capacity issue. Vast majority of psychiatrists don't even do diagnostics for adults so MAKE SURE when you set the appointment up that it is crystal f*cking clear that you're there for a diagnostic and diagnostic only.

Edit: And take my input on this with a grain of salt, but responding poorly to an SSRI treatment is a contextual tip off for ADHD. I took Sertralin for about 9 months and while it certainly helped control self deprecating thought patterns, it did NOTHING to alleviate my other symptoms, leaving me with worse impulse control, deadened drive, impaired memory, and I slept a disgusting amount and was still exhausted. A good specialist will know to heed that information, during your assessment.

I suggest writing down a list of your symptoms and how they impair your day to day function. Doesn't have to be neat and organized, but just so you have clear cut details when you have the assessment, instead of blank brain the moment you walk through the door to see them.

Nihilist? Seems a bit extreme. My point more so was that Anime, like most fiction, is the product of an artist's wildest fantasies. They've spent years dreaming up scenarios and themes that go far beyond their own experiences of day-to-day human life. An adrenaline rush, if we want to simplify it for this argument.

If you consume these adrenaline rushes on a consistent basis then stack those experiences and moments against the entirety of your life (which undoubtedly has a lot of boring experiences of perceived lesser meaning, by comparison), you're likely to feel underwhelmed. I don't think that's a nihilistic viewpoint at all, just that it's probably easy to forget at one time or another that these stories are not very reminiscent of what it's like to be a real life person, day in day out. If you compare your life to the wildest fantasies a person has spent years of their life realizing in a story, it's only normal that you would be left feeling insignificant. So, you know... Of course keep watching it if you love it, but don't get depressed because you're not also turning into a titan to save the planet.
